subject: Observability handoff & on-call readiness: dashboards, traces, alerts, runbooks
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Rami <sofia@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Aug 2029 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: Observability onboarding: proposed handoff agenda and timeline

Hi Sofia —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for the observability layer. Per our last call, I wanted to kick off a short written plan so the kickoff is crisp and the customer's on-call and runbook needs are covered from day one.

Proposed 2-week onboarding scope (high level):
- Week 0 (prep): data access + sample logs/traces, SLO targets, PagerDuty/ops routing details
- Week 1: dashboard buildout (errors, latency P95/P99, throughput), tracing hooks, span conventions
- Week 2: alert routing, escalation matrix, runbook authoring + handoff rehearsal

Key decision items for ACME:
- Primary on-call integration (PagerDuty reference key + escalation policy)
- Data residency constraint for logs/trace retention (any EU-only datasets?)
- Baseline SLOs for billing-sensitive endpoints (list attached as implementation_matrix.csv)

Attachments: obs_onboarding_mou.pdf, implementation_matrix.csv (baseline signals + owners).

Could you confirm the right attendees from your side and whether next Tuesday 8/13 10–11am PT works for a kickoff? If that slot doesn't work I can share a Calendly.

Thanks — looking forward to a smooth handoff.

Ben Carter
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Sofia Rami <sofia@acmehealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Ops Lead <ops-ops@acmehealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Aug 2029 16:45:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Observability onboarding: proposed handoff agenda and timeline

On Wed, 07 Aug 2029 at 09:12 AM Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Sofia —
> 
> Thanks again for choosing Redwood for the observability layer...

Thanks Ben — this is great and aligned with what our engineering manager expects. A few quick clarifications from Acme:
- PagerDuty: we will use the main ops team in PD (integration key available). The escalation policy has two levels before exec notification — we need Redwood alerts to map to those two tiers.
- Data residency: some PHI-adjacent traces must remain in our EU project; majority of telemetry can route to US. We will provide the project IDs.
- SLOs: we already have internal SLOs for our authentication and payments endpoints; attaching our current targets below in the thread.

Attendees: me (Sofia), Ops Lead (copied), and Diego Ruiz (engineering lead, diego@clearvista.io) will join the kickoff.

Next Tuesday 8/13 10–11am PT works for us. Please send invite. Also: can Redwood provide a runbook template we can start filling before week 2?

—Sofia
Director of Site Reliability
Acme Health
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Aug 2029 11:00:00 -0000
Subject: Internal: ACME observability handoff — pre-kickoff checklist

Team — copying a short internal checklist to ensure we land the kickoff with clear owners. Ben, please make sure Sofia has the calendar invite (Ben noted 8/13 10–11am PT).

Pre-kickoff checklist (internal owners):
- Confirm PD integration: Marissa to request PD integration key and verify escalation mapping (owner: Marissa).
- Data residency mapping: Soojin to validate EU-only retention option and note required config changes (owner: Soojin).
- Dashboard seed artifacts: Ben to prepare a short seed deck that shows panels and their sources (owner: Ben).
- Runbook template and example: Laura to attach runbook-template.md and a one-page example we can hand to ACME during week 2 (owner: Laura).
- Tiny-play rehearsal: after week 2 we will do a 30-min simulated incident with ACME — coordinate with CS and SRE (owner: Ben/Marissa).

Files attached for internal prep: handoff_checklist.xlsx, runbook-template.md. Please update the XLSX with expected dates/assignees before EOD Friday 8/9.

Notes on routing: we should recommend two alert-priority levels mapped to ACME PD policies and avoid noisy low-severity alerts by suggesting initial thresholds slightly conservative (e.g., 10m sustained error rate > 2% for auth endpoints). We can refine after week 1 dashboards.

Thanks — Laura
Customer Success Lead, Observability
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Rami <sofia@acmehealth.com>, Ops Lead <ops-ops@acmehealth.com>, Nikhil Rao <nikhil@clearvista.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Aug 2029 17:03:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Observability onboarding: proposed handoff agenda and timeline — kickoff confirmed

Hi all — thanks for the quick responses and confirming attendees. Calendar invite sent for Tue 13 Aug, 10–11am PT (link: https://calendly.com/ben-carter/redwood-obs-kickoff).

Quick recap and immediate next steps:
1) Marissa will request the PagerDuty integration key from ACME ops (Marissa, pls put request in the HubSpot ticket and copy Sofia).
2) Soojin will share EU retention configuration notes and any additional infra steps by Monday 8/12.
3) I will attach the seed dashboard deck and the MOU we discussed to the kickoff invite.
4) Laura will circulate the runbook-template.md and a one-page runbook example in the kickoff chat so ACME can start filling it during week 1.

Attachments: monitoring-implementation-plan-v1.pdf (detailed week-by-week tasks and owners).

Please reply if any of the owner assignments above need changing. Looking forward to the kickoff.

Ben Carter
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
